text: Deirdre Boyle, Manager, Accessibility Unit and Karen Mills, Accessibility Consultant, Accessibility Unit, Equity and Human Rights, People and Equity Division will provide a presentation on the 2025 - 2029 Multi-Year Accessibility Plan (MYAP). The MYAP is the City’s 5-year strategic plan to identify, remove and prevent barriers that impact City residents, visitors, and employees with disabilities. The Accessibility Unit is in the process of updating the strategic plan and will provide an overview on work underway.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
